name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Chose 6px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast. It balances visibility for low-vision users with minimal layout shift, meeting WCAG AA without the bulk of a 7:1 AAA ring. Trade-off: slightly less crisp for extreme contrast needs, but AA covers 98% of users and keeps designs clean.

name: Reader
text: The 6px ring at 4.5:1 fails users who rely on high-contrast focus indicators—like those with tunnel vision or screen-reader users who tab through dense interfaces. A 4px ring at 7:1 meets AAA and stays crisp on high-DPI screens, but it adds layout shift. Test both with real screen-reader users and measure task completion time; the faster, more accurate path wins.
